title: Male Beauty
paragraphs: “Huh? What about Tact’s close aides?”
“Bufufufu, I want a new woman.”
Ren whispered to Father. Itsuki seems to be joining in too.
“Even with so many around, he still wants more concubines?”
“Maybe he just wants to replenish them? Like those wicked women who killed heroes.”
“Didn’t Éclair say that he likes female criminals from noble families? It’s an unusual preference, but if that’s his type, it can’t be helped.”
“Maybe quite a few of them killed themselves to avoid being violated by that king? And now he wants a new heir… or something?”
“Or maybe he just got bored? He seems like the type to say that sleeping with the same woman isn’t his thing.”
“Either way, killing a hero is a serious crime in this world, right? Looking at Yuta’s women, there’s no point in defending them.”
“Well… for someone who stabbed their own comrades, maybe this is a fitting end.”
It seems that Father and the others have finished their discussion. They turned back to the Pig King and stated their conclusion.
“Understood. If that’s what the king desires…”
“Bufu! By the way, what about the Sword and Bow Heroes? Wouldn’t they enjoy some time with me? I’ve heard rumors that they might be into men.”
Again? …Wait, what did he just say? Ren and Itsuki are into men? Even I didn’t know that. Come to think of it, Ren and Itsuki do seem to be clueless about romance.
Could it be that they don’t harbor any romantic feelings for Filolial-sama because they’re into men? If Kou or Midori likes Ren or Itsuki, I wouldn’t mind introducing them.
“Don’t worry, I won’t treat you like the women.”
“We refuse with all our strength! And who said we’re into men in the first place!? Also, Motoyasu-san, why are you nodding!?”
“Who spread that rumor? I’ll kill them immediately!”
Itsuki and Ren, showing something close to genuine anger, glared at the people in the castle. It seems they’re not into men after all.
“Bufufu, I heard that despite being around women, there’s no trace of you enjoying yourselves within the castle.”
“Then what about Naofumi-san and Motoyasu-san?”
“Bufufufufu…”
The Pig King didn’t answer Itsuki’s question. No, he seems to be thinking about it.
“They’re not my type, and besides, both of them are already surrounded by women. Compared to that…”
Ren and Itsuki recoiled under the Pig King’s lecherous gaze. They looked like frogs being stared down by a snake.
“Naofumi-san, I think it’s about time I got myself a new companion. Ideally, I want a companion who’s exclusively mine!”
“Me too! If things stay like this, people will think I’m into men!”
“Ahaha… But finding a trustworthy companion isn’t easy.”
“At this point, even a filolial would do! An exclusive companion… That’s it, Éclair! Become my exclusive companion!”
“…I hear an intent in Amaki-dono’s words that sounds like you’re asking me to be your sex slave.”
“N-No, that’s not—”

“Come now, Your Majesty. Ren and Itsuki aren’t into men. They’re just being cautious because they were betrayed by their companions in Melromarc after being summoned. Since they don’t have the preferences you desire, could you let this slide?”
Father spoke to the Pig King to bring the conversation to a close. The Pig King reluctantly backed down.
“Hmm… If that’s the case, then it can’t be helped. But Sword and Bow Heroes, I’ll always be waiting for you.”
“Even if the world ends, that’s never going to happen, so you don’t have to wait.”
“Yeah! No matter how many times the world repeats, that’ll never happen, and I’ll make sure it doesn’t.”
“Then, Heroes. I’ll leave the search for the Axe of the Seven Star Weapons to you.”

Thus, after concluding our talk with the Pig King, we took on the mission to search for the Axe of the Seven Star Weapons. That said, there’s not much to do. The kingdom and the guild would host parties under some pretext and gather people, and we’d quietly chant the deprivation spell while staying hidden.
“The Love Hunter commands. Vassal weapon, respond to the call of the Love Hunter, break free from the foolish bonds of power, and awaken!”

I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve recited this. We gathered people from all over and used the spell as Father had requested. After attending these festive gatherings, we didn’t exactly lure them out, but when one of the Four Cardinal Heroes walked alone on a deserted night street or was led to a noble’s mansion where no one could see, there were always those who would ambush us.
“I mean… I can’t fight, so I can’t deal with them, but isn’t everyone having a hard time?”
Father served us homemade food as he spoke words of appreciation. Ren, Itsuki, and I all sighed in exasperation.
“Seriously. There are just too many people who think they can take weapons from heroes and form gangs with women to ambush us.”
“And most of them make up some excuse, saying our attitude rubbed them the wrong way. It’s exhausting.”

“Exactly. They latch onto something we say and get all confrontational. Then, when we pretend to get angry and grip our weapons, they go, ‘See that? I’ll prove that I’m better than you!’ and attack us.”
Isn’t this just the same old trick? Naturally, they’re getting countered.
“But I’ve mostly figured it out. Most of them are children of nobles or adventurers who have excelled in some field.”
“It seems the people of Faubrey have started to catch on as well. Apparently, in the past twenty years, a lot of geniuses have emerged, with Takt being the most prominent.”
“And most of them seem to be those so-called geniuses among nobles or adventurers who recently appeared out of nowhere and started making a name for themselves.”
“That sounds familiar. But… even as protagonists, they seem to be lacking in various ways.”
“What’s the difference?”
Ren asked Father, and Itsuki exchanged glances with him before explaining.
What’s the difference?

“It’s their lack of analytical ability. They have no awareness of what they’re actually doing. Instead of thinking about confronting the waves during a world crisis, they act selfishly and focus solely on eliminating those they dislike.”
“The idea of cooperating with the heroes and fighting for the world never crosses their minds. It’s a bit different from what you’d expect in stories.”
“Even having analytical skills might be a dangerous trait in this case.”
“Well, yeah. If they betrayed us at a critical moment, it would be a nightmare… I’m sure there are people like that.”
“But we’re not entirely without clues. We’ve figured out quite a lot.”
“Eh? Itsuki, do you have something in mind?”
“I’ve figured it out too.”
“I don’t know. For me, everything is DESTROY!”
Ren and Itsuki let out exasperated sighs at my response.
What’s with that reaction? Father, Ren, and Itsuki were similar at first, so I wouldn’t mind DESTROYING them either.
“There are cases where nobles pick fights with the heroes without any reason. But those people have one thing in common.”
“A common point?”
“Yes. When it comes to nobles’ children or unknown adventurers who have suddenly appeared and picked fights with us, there’s always someone close to them.”
“That means…”
Father seems to have realized something as well.
Who is it?
“Ah, when the tide turns against them, there’s always some scum who tries to betray and ingratiate themselves. That’s the proof.”
“It’s not like Naofumi-san from the first world that Motoyasu talked about, but… women seem scary.”
“Considering the situation, that Melromarc princess was probably the same.”
“…What is this pattern? And with the interference of those who claim to be gods… it’s getting more suspicious by the moment.”
“We can only hope that the day comes when we solve the mystery of the waves.”
“In any case, we have to prioritize the search for the Axe of the Seven Star Weapons… and make sure it ends up in the hands of a rightful wielder.”
“Indeed. Let’s hope that the Seven Star Weapon ends up with someone we can trust.”
It was at that moment. It happened during a gathering of noble heirs and adventurers in Faubrey’s region. A flash of light suddenly flew in our direction.
“W-What!?”
“That’s him!”

I stripped the noble’s son of the Axe of the Seven Star Weapons and pointed at him. He was the third son of a noble whose domain management had been improving recently, with a background similar to Takt’s.
“Bubuu!”
Sure enough, he had surrounded himself with a few pigs.
“You are under arrest… for the murder of a Seven Star Hero!”
Itsuki pointed his gun at the noble who had been hiding the Axe of the Seven Star Weapons.
